summary: Coffee Holding Co., Inc. (NASDAQ: JVA) filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors approved a share repurchase program authorizing up to $2.5 million in value of its outstanding common stock, par value $0.001 per share. Repurchases may occur from time to time on the open market and in privately negotiated transactions, funded with available cash and future operating cash flow, and may be executed partly under a Rule 10b5-1 plan. No price, premium, or expiration date was stated. Watch for execution pace, liquidity, and any program suspension.
